    feat(interface-design): route web work through current standards and one design foundation
    
    Web and interface work now classifies the product, applies a cited standards floor, keeps one design foundation per surface, queries Modern Web Guidance against the Baseline target, and gates markup with a deterministic anti-slop detector. Steward keeps a device record and installs shared tools at their latest release, Writerside follows the newest builder, and Maestro parks deferred work as dormant sessions woken only with approval.

    feat(steward): enforce the guard in Codex, Antigravity, and Copilot
    
    The guard now recognises each agent host from its hook input and answers in that host's format, so Antigravity and Copilot refuse throwaway containers and in-repository backup copies and continue a turn while leftovers remain, with loop protection on every host.
